descriptionByLocale.en:
Privatklinik Wyss AG is a leading specialist clinic for psychiatry and psychotherapy. Special areas of expertise include the treatment of depression including burnout and anxiety and obsessive-compulsive disorders. The clinic offers its outpatient, daily clinical and inpatient services in the region of Bern, Münchenbuchsee and Biel and employs around 340 employees at all three locations. Apprenticeship specialist / health professional EFZ August 2027 (m/f/d) employment level 100 % temporary employment location Privatklinik Wyss AG Start of work 1. August 2027 The training as a specialist health EFZ (FaGe) will accompany and support patients in everyday life. You take on nursing, medical, administrative and logistical tasks. You rotate the department every year and acquire competences corresponding to your training level. To expand these skills, you will complete an internal internship in housekeeping and an external one in a retirement residence. During your training, you will be accompanied individually and competently by a vocational trainer in the department in your learning process. Preparatory training
• Secondary school or high school qualification
• Completed elementary school with good performances
• Enjoyment of teamwork
• High communication capability
• Physical and psychological resilience
• Enjoy working with different professional groups
• Good understanding
• Organisational skill Duration and completion

• Professional Maturity (BM1)
• Access to nursing training HF (shortened degree programme)

• Grösstenteils betreust du unsere Tiere und sorgst für deren Wohl und Gesundheit indem du ihre artgerechte Haltung sicherstellst
• Du führst die in der Tierpflege anfallenden Arbeiten selbständig aus – im Rahmen der Vorgaben unserer Fachverantwortlichen Tierpflege. Eigene Vorschläge und dein Fachwissen bringst du dabei aktiv ein und gestaltest die Tierpflege mit.
• Daneben führst du regelmässige Tiertrainings durch und bringst Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge zur Weiterentwicklung des Tierparks ein.
• Du führst eigenständig und zuverlässig Tiergestützte Interventionen (bis maximal zwei Stunden pro Tag) durch und unterstützt die therapeutische Zielsetzung gemäss Fallführung
• Du arbeitest im interprofessionellen Behandlungsteam mit. Das bringst du mit Du hast einen eidgenössischen Fähigkeitsausweis in Tierpflege oder mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Pflege von verschiedenen Tierarten. Eine Ausbildung in Tiergestützter Intervention (TGI) oder Interesse diese zu absolvieren rundet dein Profil ab. Du hast Spass an der Tierpflege und der Interaktion mit Menschen. Geduld und Flexibilität zählen zu deinen Stärken? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Die interprofessionelle Zusammenarbeit macht dir Freude und du bist angetrieben Dinge weiterzuentwickeln und zu verbessern? Jetzt freuen wir uns umso mehr auf dein Dossier! Das darfst du von uns erwarten Als KMU mit einer ansehnlichen Grösse sind die Arbeitstage sehr abwechslungsreich und bieten Vielfalt und Gestaltungsmöglichkeit. Der Kontakt zu den Kolleg*innen ist persönlich und die Entscheidungswege sind kurz. Wir sind mit flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen unterwegs und nutzen, wo immer möglich Technologien, um unsere Flexibilität zu stützen. Wir zählen auf Eigenverantwortung sowie die Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und fördern diese in deren Weiterentwicklung. Dicembre 2026 o su appuntamento #naturnah, #sustainable, #respectful, #supportive, #flexible: La diversità in un ambiente familiare e benevolo vi aspetta! Nell'ambito del nostro team Park/Tierpark (7 persone, 5.5 posizioni a tempo pieno), vi occuperete di tutti gli animali del nostro zoo – da alpaca, polli e capre nane a emus, wallaby e tartarughe a maiali, conigli e pecore. Oltre alla cura degli animali, accompagni i pazienti individualmente o in gruppi nel senso di interventi assistiti da animali, che si svolgono fino a due volte al giorno. La nostra struttura esterna bella e certificata è un incontro e un ritiro per i nostri pazienti e dipendenti ed è anche ben visitato dalla popolazione locale. Un mix emozionante di compiti in un ambiente diverso vi aspetta, che vi sfida sia nel rispettoso trattamento di esseri umani e animali e allo stesso tempo vi offre un sacco di spazio per il vostro proprio sviluppo. Questo è ciò che il vostro giorno professionale sembra con noi
• Per la maggior parte, si prende cura dei nostri animali e prendersi cura del loro benessere e la salute assicurando il loro benessere.
• Effettuate il lavoro nella cura degli animali in modo indipendente – nel quadro delle specifiche della nostra cura animale specializzata. Contribuisci attivamente i tuoi suggerimenti e le tue conoscenze specialistiche e modella la cura degli animali.
• Inoltre, si effettua la formazione animale regolare e portare idee e suggerimenti per il miglioramento per l'ulteriore sviluppo dello zoo.
• Si esegue in modo indipendente e affidabile interventi assistiti da animali (fino ad un massimo di due ore al giorno) e sostenere l'obiettivo terapeutico secondo la gestione dei casi
• Lavori nel team di terapia interprofessionale. Hai un certificato federale di abilità nella cura degli animali o diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella cura di diverse specie animali. Formazione in Intervento Animale Assistito (TGI) o interesse a completarlo completa il tuo profilo. Ti piace la cura degli animali e l'interazione con le persone. Pazienza e flessibilità sono i vostri punti di forza? Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione. La cooperazione interprofessionale ti dà piacere e sei spinto a sviluppare e migliorare le cose? Ora siamo tutti più ansiosi del vostro dossier! Come PMI di dimensioni considerevoli, le giornate di lavoro sono molto varie e offrono possibilità di design e varietà. Il contatto con i colleghi è personale e i percorsi decisionali sono brevi. Operiamo con modelli flessibili di tempo di lavoro e tecnologia d'uso ovunque possibile per supportare la nostra flessibilità. Contiamo sulla responsabilità personale e le competenze dei nostri dipendenti e li promuoviamo nel loro ulteriore sviluppo. La nostra cultura aziendale unica e i nostri principi di gestione sono parte integrante del nostro lavoro quotidiano e quindi ci danno un quadro adatto per lavorare a livello degli occhi. Privatklinik Wyss AG is a leading specialist clinic for psychiatry and psychotherapy. Special areas of expertise include the treatment of depression including burnout and anxiety and obsessive-compulsive disorders. The clinic offers its outpatient, daily clinical and inpatient services in the region of Bern, Münchenbuchsee and Biel and employs around 340 employees at all three locations. Employee*in Tierpark and animal-assisted interventions (m/f/d) employment level 60% - 80% employment relationship permanent location Privatklinik Wyss AG Start of work Per 1. December 2026 or by appointment #naturnah, #sustainable, #respectful, #supportive, #flexible: Diversity in a family and benevolent environment awaits you! As part of our team Park/Tierpark (7 people, 5.5 full-time positions), you will take care of all the animals in our zoo – from alpacas, chickens and dwarf goats to emus, wallabies and turtles to pigs, rabbits and sheep. In addition to animal care, you accompany patients individually or in groups in the sense of animal-assisted interventions, which take place up to twice a day. Our beautiful and certified outdoor facility is a meeting and retreat for our patients and employees and is also well visited by the local population. An exciting mix of tasks in a diverse environment awaits you, which challenges you both in the respectful treatment of humans and animals and at the same time offers you a lot of space for your own development. This is what your professional day looks like with us
• For the most part, you look after our animals and take care of their well-being and health by ensuring their welfare.
• You carry out the work in the animal care independently – within the framework of the specifications of our specialist animal care. You actively contribute your own suggestions and expertise and help shape animal care.
• In addition, you carry out regular animal training and bring ideas and suggestions for improvement to the further development of the zoo.
• You perform independently and reliably animal-assisted interventions (up to a maximum of two hours per day) and support the therapeutic goal according to case management
• You work in the interprofessional treatment team. You have a federal certificate of ability in animal care or several years of professional experience in the care of different animal species. Training in Animal Assisted Intervention (TGI) or interest in completing it completes your profile. You enjoy animal care and interaction with people. Patience and flexibility are your strengths? We look forward to your application. Interprofessional cooperation gives you pleasure and you are driven to develop and improve things? Now we are all the more looking forward to your dossier! As an SME with a considerable size, the working days are very varied and offer variety and design possibilities. The contact with the colleagues is personal and the decision paths are short. We operate with flexible working time models and use technology wherever possible to support our flexibility. We count on personal responsibility and the skills of our employees and promote them in their further development. Our unique company culture and our management principles are an integral part of our daily work and thus give us a suitable framework for working at eye level. Les domaines d'expertise particuliers comprennent le traitement de la dépression, y compris l'épuisement ainsi que l'anxiété et les troubles obsessionnels-compulsifs. La clinique offre ses services ambulatoires, cliniques quotidiens et hospitaliers dans la région de Berne, Münchenbuchsee et Biel et emploie environ 340 employés dans les trois localités. Salariés*dans le parc Tier et interventions assistées par des animaux (h/f/d) niveau d'emploi 60% - 80% relation d'emploi emplacement permanent Privatklinik Wyss AG Début du travail Per 1. En plus des soins aux animaux, vous accompagnez les patients individuellement ou en groupe dans le sens d'interventions assistées par des animaux, qui se déroulent jusqu'à deux fois par jour. Notre belle et certifiée installation extérieure est une réunion et une retraite pour nos patients et employés et est également bien visité par la population locale. Un mélange passionnant de tâches dans un environnement diversifié vous attend, ce qui vous défie à la fois dans le traitement respectueux des humains et des animaux et vous offre en même temps beaucoup d'espace pour votre propre développement. • Pour la plupart, vous prenez soin de nos animaux et prenez soin de leur bien-être et de leur santé en assurant leur bien-être.
• Vous effectuez le travail dans le soin des animaux indépendamment – dans le cadre des spécifications de notre soin des animaux spécialisés. Vous apportez activement vos propres suggestions et vos connaissances spécialisées et façonnez les soins aux animaux.
• En outre, vous effectuez régulièrement une formation animale et apportez des idées et des suggestions d'amélioration pour le développement du zoo.
